name: Mana: miy mylyy koshmar
source:
But even if you lost everything, you have the opportunity to start a new life. What will it be like? It depends only on you. A guy with a turbulent past settles in a cozy apartment, but he can't even dream of peace. Mana, his new neighbor, does not want to share the house with anyone. Who is she, how is she related to his past, and what the hell to do with all this now? Trying to find a common language with an unusual girl, our hero plunges into a whirlpool of memories and finds answers to difficult questions.

[Translated from [url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/6669995556]Itch.io[/url]]
